tokens.name: brand-signal
tokens.usage: Signal Orange, the primary brand color. Brighter and more saturated than the legacy #F37A20 / #EF5123. Fills, CTAs, the logo's left plane, key data. Never body text on paper (2.9:1): use accent-ink there.

tokens.name: brand-flare
tokens.usage: Flare, the light end of the orange range. Logo right plane, top of the Ascent gradient, highlights, focus ring on carbon.

tokens.name: brand-ember
tokens.usage: Ember, the deep end of the orange range. Logo base plane, bottom of the Ascent gradient, pressed states. Carbon text on it holds 4.6:1.

tokens.name: brand-glow
tokens.usage: Glow, a light orange tint. Light emitted from layers in imagery, soft highlights, chart fills. Decorative; carbon text on it holds 12:1.

tokens.name: brand-carbon
tokens.usage: Carbon, a warm near-black. The primary brand ground: dark sections, the hero, video backgrounds, text on orange.

tokens.name: brand-graphite
tokens.usage: Graphite. Raised surfaces on carbon, code blocks, dark cards.

tokens.name: brand-paper
tokens.usage: Paper, a warm off-white. Light sections and documents. Kept slightly warm so orange sits naturally on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, form fields, code blocks.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells, alternating section bands, table stripes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and dividers only. Below 3:1, so never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders, secondary-button borders, chart axes. At least 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headlines, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (15:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, metadata, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken (5.8:1 or more).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, active states, the one highlighted word or number per view, progress. A fill: put on-accent text on it.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent fills. on-accent stays legible (8.3:1).

tokens.name: accent-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent, accent-hover and brand-glow fills (6.2:1 on accent). Carbon on orange is a TekRevol signature: never white text on Signal Orange below 24px.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Orange used AS TEXT: links, inline highlights, eyebrow labels. On surface and surface-raised (5.7:1 or more in both themes) and on accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind accent-ink: selected rows, tag fills, callouts.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring with a 2px gap in the surface color. 7:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success states, always with a word or check icon. On surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning states, always with a word or icon. On surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, always with a word or icon, since danger sits close to the brand orange.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational notes and neutral system messages.

tokens.name: data-1
tokens.usage: Charts: the series that is TekRevol or the result being highlighted.

tokens.name: data-2
tokens.usage: Charts: the comparison series. Cyan sits opposite orange, so the two read apart in lightness and hue.

tokens.name: data-3
tokens.usage: Charts: third series.

tokens.name: data-4
tokens.usage: Charts: baseline, benchmark or 'everything else'.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Homepage hero only. One per page. Mobile: 44px.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section openers and campaign headlines. Mobile: 36px.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page H1 on inner pages. Mobile: 32px.

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: How we take a prototype to production

styles.name: h3
styles.sample: Built for HIPAA from the first sprint

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Most clients arrive after something else has gone wrong. We take it from there.
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under a headline. Max 60 characters per line.

styles.name: h4
styles.sample: Same team from kickoff to launch
styles.usage: Small headings, list titles, table headers. Set in Archivo, not the display face.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Compliance is built in from the first sprint, not added before delivery.
styles.usage: All running text. 60 to 75 characters per line.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: One point of contact, start to finish.
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy. Prefer it to italics.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons and nav links. Sentence case.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, tags, section labels. Always UPPERCASE. accent-ink or ink-muted.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code, code blocks, technical specs.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Proof numbers (800+ products, 4.8/5 Clutch). Only sourced numbers. Mobile: 32px.

spacing.note: 4px base unit. Every margin, padding and gap is one of these steps.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap, tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its control; tag padding (vertical).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding; gap inside small groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap; mobile page gutter; card padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Grid gutter on desktop; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between heading and body block.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between components inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablet.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-11
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding on desktop.

radius.note: TekRevol is mostly square. Its signature corner is the notch (see the cut family).

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Sections, images, the Strata motif, large cards.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small cards, menus, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and avatars only. Never buttons.

cut.note: The notch: a 45 degree corner cut taken from the diagonal planes of the logo mark. Applied with clip-path to the top-right corner.

tokens.name: notch-sm
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and tags.

tokens.name: notch-md
tokens.usage: Cards and image frames.

tokens.name: notch-lg
tokens.usage: Hero panels and feature blocks.

shadow.note: Depth comes from light, not drop shadows. Use glow on carbon; use lift sparingly on paper.

tokens.name: glow-accent
tokens.usage: Hovered primary cards and the featured item on carbon.

tokens.name: lift
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and modals.

duration.note: Motion timing. Respect prefers-reduced-motion: drop to instant.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, focus, color changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Menus, tabs, small reveals.

tokens.name: duration-build
tokens.usage: The layer build-up: elements stacking into place.

tokens.name: stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between stacked layers in a build-up.

tokens.name: ease-build
tokens.usage: Things arriving and settling: layers, cards, headlines.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Max content width.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of running text.

tokens.name: columns-desktop
tokens.usage: Grid columns at 1024px and up, 24px gutters.

tokens.name: columns-tablet
tokens.usage: Grid columns at 640 to 1023px, 24px gutters.

tokens.name: columns-mobile
tokens.usage: Grid columns below 640px, 16px gutters and 16px side margins.
